chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"If a woman dies in her postpartum state, no record will be unfolded for her on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being described in the hadith
key_terms.دِيوَانٌ: the record or register of deeds

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling or spiritual status of a woman who dies during childbirth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a woman dies in her state of nifas after childbirth, her record is not unfolded on the Day of Resurrection. It points to a special divine consideration for her state and connects death in childbirth with the realities of the afterlife.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If a woman dies during childbirth (in her postpartum state), no record of her deeds will be unfurled on the Day of Resurrection."
